Illustrative project scene

Give employers evidence
of your ability to contribute.

Employers and clients look for evidence that you can deliver: understand a brief, complete a task, solve problems and explain your contribution.

Build that evidence through Bluzee Academy of Experience’s six-month pathway. Apply your skills to scoped, reviewed assignments and develop a portfolio grounded in practical work.

On successful completion of the applicable programme requirements, receive a Bluzee experience certificate supported by documented contributions. Approach suitable early-career opportunities with a stronger story than training alone.

Reviewed workProject evidenceExperience certificate

Programme duration, assignment access and certification requirements are confirmed at enrolment. Employer acceptance, experience classification and job eligibility depend on each role; employment is not guaranteed.
